data.body: Implementation kickoff: plan-review currency check returned certified PASS at 12a10f3ab4effc1fbad58f47c1dab80e34f07744 immediately before the atomic claim. Working in isolated worktree comment-remediation-e328 from origin/main 98a02f975aef1. Scope is documentation-only across the 23 allowlisted true docstrings in 18 owned unit-test files. Behavioral held-out TDD is inapplicable because executable behavior must remain byte-equivalent; the ticket's normalized-AST, token/directive, path, hygiene, Ruff, and focused-test guards are the oracle. Per operator direction, full local make verify is replaced by the scoped commands and Gerrit Verified CI.
